title: F · Render and inspect one or two pages
summary: Measure with actual renderer typography and flowables; preserve all mandatory sections and useful content.
body:
Measure with actual renderer typography and flowables; preserve all mandatory sections and useful content.

Keep readable fonts/spacing and prevent stranded headings. No silent font shrinking.

If three pages: inspect formatting, duplication and verbose wording first. If still too long, preserve draft and report it.

Never remove the project or employer; never shorten the letter to solve resume overflow.

Use actual PDF pagination/page images; text judgments cannot certify layout.

Final rendering/repair changes feed back into final-text coverage. The old one-page subset search is superseded.
